name: PCBWay standard PCB capabilities
notes: The 'Standard PCB' table (1-14 layers, FR-4). The page lists one track/space value for all copper weights and layers.
Holes smaller than 0.2 mm or larger than 6 mm are charged extra.
The annular ring value (0.15 mm) is given for via pads only; component-hole rings are not stated.
Not stated for this tier and therefore not checked: NPTH minimum, slots, hole-to-hole, hole-to-track, copper-to-edge, aspect ratio, solder mask bridge.
The Advanced PCB table (Normal / Medium / High difficulty per copper weight) is not encoded yet: its column mapping is ambiguous on the page.
